column1: # Dimension estimates are sample-size-dependent lower bounds; compare only at matched n_control_used. Where n_control_used < n_genes the sample covariance is rank-deficient (rank bound n-1) and both effective rank and the variance-threshold counts are contaminated by sampling noise in the trailing eigenvalues: across the three Frangieh arms they track a roughly fixed fraction of n (effective rank 0.56-0.64n, 95pct count 0.71-0.80n). Participation ratio is dominated by the leading eigenvalues and is the estimator comparable across datasets.
